name: ComponentDefaults
description: Utility provider that sets the default control size for every control below it.

controlSize.description: Default size for controls that do not pass their own size prop. A control without the step renders its nearest one (xs falls back to sm).

when: A region needs every control at one size (dense table toolbars, compact sidebars, inspector panels)
A subtree should default to xs, sm or lg controls without repeating the size prop
whenNot: Sizing a single control (pass its size prop)
Changing spacing or typography (use tokens, not control size)
guidelines: The one entry point for default control size: it renders no element and paints nothing
Nest providers to override the size for a smaller region; an omitted controlSize inherits the parent
An explicit size prop on a control always wins over the provider default
Composes with the theme scale: the provider picks the step (xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 40), --fui-scale multiplies every step
A control that draws no xs step renders sm inside an xs region
accessibility: xs and sm controls still meet the kit's minimum target size through the hit-area recipe

examples.name: Dense Toolbar
examples.description: Every control in the toolbar defaults to sm without repeating the prop.

examples.name: Nested Override
examples.description: A nested provider narrows the default for one region.
examples.code:
<ComponentDefaultsProvider controlSize="lg">
  <Button>Large by default</Button>
  <ComponentDefaultsProvider controlSize="sm">
    <Button>Small in this region</Button>
  </ComponentDefaultsProvider>
</ComponentDefaultsProvider>

examples.name: Inspector
examples.description: An xs region: IconButton and Button draw the 24px step.
examples.code:
import { Plus } from "@phosphor-icons/react";

<ComponentDefaultsProvider controlSize="xs">
  <Stack direction="row" gap="xs">
    <IconButton aria-label="Add">
      <Plus aria-hidden />
    </IconButton>
    <Button variant="ghost">Reset</Button>
  </Stack>
</ComponentDefaultsProvider>

relations.note: Theme sets --fui-scale; the provider picks the step that scale multiplies
Controls resolve their size through useResolvedControlSize

propsSummary: controlSize: xs|sm|md|lg - default size for controls below the provider
CONTROL_SIZES - the four steps, smallest first
useResolvedControlSize(explicit, steps?) - explicit > provider (clamped to steps) > md
